import functools
import json
import os
import time
from typing import Dict, Any
import cachetools
import aiohttp
import logging
from datetime import timedelta

CACHE_TTL = timedelta(minutes=10)  # Cache Time-to-Live
PRIMARY_API_KEY = os.environ['PRIMARY_API_KEY']
FALLBACK_API_KEY = os.environ['FALLBACK_API_KEY']

async def _get_data(url: str, api_key: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get(url, headers={'api-key': api_key}) as response:
            if response.status != 200:
                logging.warning(f"API request failed: {response.status}")
                return {}
            return await response.json()

@cachetools.TTLCache(maxsize=128, ttl=CACHE_TTL)
async def get_city_data(city: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    primary_weather_url = f"https://api.primary-weather.com/v1/{city}/forecast"
    primary_traffic_url = f"https://api.primary-traffic.com/v1/{city}"
    primary_events_url = f"https://api.primary-events.com/v1/{city}/upcoming"

    data = await functools.reduce(

        [(_get_data, (primary_weather_url, PRIMARY_API_KEY)),
         (_get_data, (primary_traffic_url, PRIMARY_API_KEY)),
         (_get_data, (primary_events_url, PRIMARY_API_KEY))],
        {}
    )

    if not data:

        fallback_traffic_url = f"https://api.fallback-traffic.com/v1/{city}"

            [(_get_data, (fallback_weather_url, FALLBACK_API_KEY)),
             (_get_data, (fallback_traffic_url, FALLBACK_API_KEY))],
            {}
        )

    return data

async def main(city: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
